name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme (TLS)
shortDescription: Term loan assistance for viable income-generating business ventures for Scheduled Caste individuals.

organization.name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation
organization.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

conditions.description: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000 for rural and urban areas.
Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
Project unit cost must not exceed ₹50,00,000.

financialBenefits.subsidy: Up to ₹10,000 or 10% of project cost (as applicable via SCAs)
financialBenefits.marginMoney: Up to 90% of project cost funded by NSFDC
financialBenefits.interestRate: 6% to 9% p.a. depending on loan slab
financialBenefits.repaymentPeriod: Up to 5 to 10 years including moratorium

applicationRoute.name: State Channelizing Agency (SCA) / RRB
applicationRoute.description: Submit application through https://nsfdc.nic.in/faqs State Scheduled Castes Development Corporation (SCA) or designated RRB branch.

sources.title: NSFDC Lending Guidelines - Term Loan Scheme
sources.organization: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
shortDescription: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
